summary:
Iter 24 — Verified P0 approvals-badge-count fix, Grid cell_meta tooltips (P/HD/LT/LV/TR/CO/PS/BK), and the new /admin/churn-risk page + endpoint. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_review_iter24.py (9 tests, all passing) alongside the pre-existing test_churn_and_approvals_summary.py (7 tests, all passing) — 16/16 pass. UI verified via Playwright on the preview URL: (a) Sidebar Approvals badge = 17, page tabs show All 19 · Leaves 1 · Check-ins 0 · Corrections 18 — summary <= actual queues (reconciliation guarantee holds; phantom-badge bug fixed). (b) Grid tooltips are exact per spec — sample BK cell tooltip: 'Break (member-scoped) · Wed · Jul 01, 2026
Break: General break
Window: 2026-07-01 → 2026-07-10
Applied by Campus Administrator on Jul 10, 2026'. P cell tooltip carries In: HH:MM / Out: HH:MM. LV/TR cells carry Window + Reason + 'Approved by <admin>'. (c) /admin/churn-risk renders with all documented data-testids (page/refresh/window/threshold/export/table + churn-cat-{all,athlete,elite,rest}, churn-band-{all,critical,high,watch}); window opts [14,30,60,90], threshold opts [0.25,0.4,0.5,0.75], 119 rows shown, tel: links wired for father/self contacts. ApprovalsUnified page renders all three queues via Promise.allSettled — verified by seeing Leaves + Check-ins + Corrections tabs all populated even though internal counts diverge slightly.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor spec deviation: the review request calls the third category chip 'Staff & Coaches' with implied testid `churn-cat-staff`, but the actual testid is `churn-cat-rest` (keyed on the backend `category=rest` bucket which is 'not athlete-like' — includes executives). The visible label is 'Staff & Coaches'. Not a bug — just noting the testid key drift vs the review-request wording so downstream automation authors don't hunt for `-staff`.

routes/reports.py churn_risk() — the `min_scheduled` guard defaults to 5 but is exposed as a query param with no upper cap. A caller passing `min_scheduled=999` will always return zero rows silently. Consider clamping to <= window_days at request-time.

routes/reports.py churn_risk() — `absent_days[-10:]` caps the payload but does not surface a 'truncated' flag. Frontend showing 'Absent since <last_seen>' can look inconsistent with the array when the streak is longer than 10 days. Consider returning `absent_days_total` alongside the trimmed list.

routes/reports.py calendar_grid() — the admin_name_by_id lookup uses `db.users.find({'id': {'$in': admin_ids}})` but if a break was applied by a since-deleted admin (soft-delete via status='left'), `applied_by` silently drops from the tooltip. Consider also querying with status filter removed or storing the applier's name at write-time on the break doc for immutability.

routes/leaves.py enrich_leaves() — now defensive (skips rows without user_id via `if leave.get('user_id')`). Consider logging a warning when a legacy row is skipped so orphaned rows surface in data-quality reports rather than silently rendering with empty member_name.

frontend/pages/admin/ChurnRisk.jsx — window/threshold `<select>` uses native browser select rather than the shadcn Select shared elsewhere in the app; minor visual inconsistency with the rest of Reports pages (which use shadcn). Not blocking but worth aligning for polish.

frontend/pages/admin/ApprovalsUnified.jsx — Promise.allSettled correctly isolates failures per queue. Verify a toast fires for the failing queue by name (couldn't force a failure to observe on preview DB where all queues are healthy). Suggest a Storybook / manual QA test with a temporary 500 in one endpoint to eyeball the toast copy.

The Grid tooltip is delivered via a native HTML `title=` attribute — this works but has known UX drawbacks: (a) ~500ms hover delay browser-imposed, (b) truncated on small viewports, (c) not tab-focusable for keyboard users. Consider migrating to a shadcn Tooltip / Radix popover once the feature is more mature — the multi-line format is already ideal for a richer component.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every acceptance criterion in the review request verified via Playwright on the preview URL

test_credentials: admin@attendance.app / Admin@12345 via the 'Admin sign in with email' collapsible on /login (phone-first entry is the default). Note: the login <form> has TWO submit buttons — the top 'Continue' triggers phone-flow validation; the bottom 'Sign in' (revealed only after clicking the toggle) is what actually POSTs email creds. Playwright must click the 'Sign in' text button specifically, not a generic button[type=submit].
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only verification of existing preview DB (which already contains a rich mix of BK/LV/TR/P cells for Jul 2026 across 134 members — sufficient for cell_meta shape assertions).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feb 2026 P0+P2 work verified 10 Jul 2026. Preview URL: https://attendance-portal-56.preview.emergentagent.com. Key tests: `pytest backend/tests/test_review_iter24.py backend/tests/test_churn_and_approvals_summary.py` — 16/16. Iteration-24 tests cover: (i) /api/leaves defensive shape (returns 200 even with legacy rows), (ii) /api/admin/approvals-summary reconciliation (summary counts <= actual queue counts + overtime=0 + total is arithmetic sum), (iii) /api/reports/calendar-grid cell_meta shape per cell code (P/HD/LT surface check_in_at + optional late_minutes; LV/TR/CO/PS surface range + optional reason + approved_by; BK surfaces break_name + range + applied_by), (iv) /api/reports/churn-risk deep row shape (contact.{relation,name,mobile}, last_seen, absent_days list, risk_band ∈ {critical,high,watch}), (v) sort invariant (miss_pct desc → streak desc), (vi) param validation (threshold >1.0 or <0 → 400; window_days>180 → silently clamped to 180 with 200), (vii) auth guard (401/403 unauthenticated). Frontend testids on /admin/churn-risk are namespaced with `churn-*` — see review-request list; category chip for Staff & Coaches uses key `rest` (backend semantics), not `staff`. Pre-existing test_reports_gating_and_ledger.py and test_ishowedup_api.py test_13/14 failures are order-dependent shared_state issues and are unrelated to this iteration — do not chase them.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — feature acceptance pass. Phantom-badge bug reproduction: prior to this session's fix, /api/admin/approvals-summary counted DB rows without joining against live user IDs, so leaves belonging to deleted users still counted. The reconciled implementation in routes/checkin_approvals.py now $lookup's the users collection (or its equivalent) and drops orphans — verified by the test that asserts summary.leaves <= len(pending_leaves) from /api/leaves (which enrich_leaves already filters via user_id presence).
